d:
Ustad Vilayat Khan (Sitar) and Ustad Shujaat Khan (Surbahar) - the Father & Son (Guru & Disciple) Duo, accompanied by Ustad Sabir Khan (Tabla) present a duet in Ragas Shahana & Bageshri, at London's Royal Festival Hall (Nov 1993).
In this video clip we have excerpts from Raga Shahana (Alap & Gat) and Raga Bageshri (Gat).
